chunk_config.note: 150 wpm spoken English: 75 words is about 30s, 150 words is about 60s. Target is about 45s. Overlap is the fraction of the previous chunk repeated, snapped to a sentence boundary. start_s and end_s stay null for these text chunks.

excluded_models.reason: Benchmarked in W1-B, then excluded on lineage review (CTO, PR #2): the paper uses BAAI BGE-M3 to filter hard negatives for English and multilingual data (arXiv:2502.07972 sec. 4.4). AGENTS.md excludes models built with PRC models. Weaker notes: English pretraining pairs inherit Nomic v1 gte-base consistency filtering (arXiv:2402.01613); the sec. 7.3 ablation found Stella 1.5B (Qwen2-based) the best negative-mining teacher, final teacher not stated. Also the only trust_remote_code load.

granite-english-r2.lineage: IBM-trained encoder, pretrained from scratch by IBM with the ModernBERT architecture recipe (no ModernBERT weights). Distilled from an IBM-tuned Mistral teacher. No MS-MARCO. No PRC base or teacher model.
